content: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: AI will completely replace teachers in the future.
AI has both benefits and challenges in education.
Traditional classrooms are no longer useful.
passage:
Artificial Intelligence in Education
Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly common in educational environments. From personalized learning platforms to automated assessment systems, AI offers opportunities to improve teaching and learning.

One major advantage of AI is its ability to adapt educational content to individual students. Traditional classrooms often require teachers to deliver the same lesson to students with different abilities. AI-powered platforms, however, can analyze students' performance and recommend exercises that match their learning needs.

Another benefit is immediate feedback. Instead of waiting for teachers to grade assignments, students can receive instant responses from automated systems. This allows them to identify mistakes and improve their understanding more efficiently.

Despite these advantages, the use of AI in education also raises concerns. Some educators worry that excessive dependence on technology may reduce students' ability to think independently. Privacy is another issue because AI systems often collect large amounts of personal learning data.

Therefore, experts suggest that AI should support rather than replace teachers. Human interaction remains essential for developing creativity, communication skills and emotional intelligence.
